title: Hybrid Se/melanin-like nanoparticles as ROS quenchers and inhibitors of amyloid aggregation.
abstract: Hybrid selenium/melanin-like nanoparticles offer different therapeutic strategies against amyloid aggregation. In this study, novel Se-based nanostructures are synthesized, characterized, and preliminarily employed as modulators of amyloid aggregation. In detail, two types of Se NPs are tested: one containing only Se(0), named Se NPs, and the second hybrid Se/melanin structures, indicated as SeMel NPs. Advanced biophysical and spectroscopic analyses elucidate the structures of NPs and the mechanistic underpinnings of the inhibition of aggregation of two protein fragments employed as amyloid models, Aβ
